pipeline: tools/art/bldkit_b.py (shared structure kit, unchanged); icon renderer env_civic_3d.render_icon (unchanged)
method: code-placed primitives in Blender (bpy module): extruded T-wall cross-section (jersey-profile foot, battered slab) in three pours, rebar lifting loops, team-colour band (material SA_Team, tinted in game), stencil plate, drainage slots; separate end post. Procedural tileable numpy surfaces (grey cast concrete with form-tie dots); Cycles CPU bake of colour x AO into one JPEG atlas per model; GLB export with the atlas embedded
tools: Blender (bpy), numpy, Pillow - no AI image generation, no external textures, scans or photos
creator: Claude (construction/garrison engineer agent), Steel Accord B3
content_notes: Generic precast barrier; no markings, logos, writing or emblems (the stencil plate is blank).
conventions: 1 unit = 1 m; origin = footprint centre at ground level; front faces Godot +Z (Blender -Y). Segment footprint 6 x 2 m, panel ends exactly at x = +-3 so segments butt together; the game scales a segment along X (0.5-1.35) to fit a drawn line exactly.
